x: Morgan was seen out in our team and ran well, but Wilson was rather a weak link and Basford had to give way to Pallett over the last stage. On June 17th the 1 Mile Team race was held at the Civil Service meeting, and here Herne Hill H. scored a surprise win and so consolidated their lead at the head of the table.
Herne Hill owed much to the versatility of Pallett, whilst McIntosh's win in the mile for H.H.H. was probably the best performance of the evening.

Eddie Pack ran the 440 yards stage and did well in handing over third behind Whittingham and Pallett. Stroud and Bone both did their bit in keeping this position; and Tommy went off about 30 yards behind the leaders, who were A.
Herne Hill Harriers' success in the Surrey County Relay event is due to the fact that they have in their ranks two very fine athletes, Pallett and Pell.
